description:
Get current oracle and DEX prices used by the Jingswap auction. Returns Pyth oracle prices (BTC/USD, STX/USD with confidence and freshness), on-chain DEX prices (XYK pool with TVL, DLMM), and the derived price ratio.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: jingswap_get_prices
